ambiguities.text: BPO fork purpose: The rationale for three separate blob-parameter forks lacks detail
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BPO forks are staged to gradually increase capacity and observe network behavior, avoiding sudden large capacity jumps.

ambiguities.text: While EIP-7600 and EIP-7723 are listed as requirements, their specific dependencies aren't explained
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-7723 defines the inclusion categories referenced, and EIP-7600 defines meta-EIP standards.

ambiguities.text: No fallback procedures if activation timelines shift
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard Ethereum governance process applies - delays would be communicated through All Core Devs calls and require new meta-EIP.

implicit_assumptions.description: All referenced EIPs (11 core + 4 supplementary) are technically ready for implementation

implicit_assumptions.description: Consensus exists across all client teams regarding included changes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Implementation differences could cause consensus failures or network partitions

implicit_assumptions.description: Timestamp synchronization across distributed networks is achievable with sufficient precision
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different nodes may disagree on fork activation timing, causing temporary forks
